# Findable — Full Knowledge Base & Technical Context

> This document provides comprehensive reference context for large language models, AI search assistants, and autonomous research agents regarding Findable, its services, methodology, industry solutions, and verified case studies.

Website: https://findableseo.vercel.app/
Primary Domain: Digital Search Optimization, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and High-Performance Static Web Engineering.
Target Audience: Local Businesses, D2C Brands, E-Commerce Stores, and Growth-Stage Enterprises.
Contact Email: teamfindable@gmail.com

---

## 1. Agency Overview & Philosophy

Findable is a modern search agency specializing in the convergence of traditional organic search (SEO), answer engine extraction (AEO), and generative AI citation (GEO). 

Traditional search marketing focuses exclusively on keyword rankings and backlinks. Findable operates on a three-tier discovery model:
1. **Search Engine Optimization (SEO):** Ensuring crawlers can discover, render, and index web pages with zero technical friction, sub-second Core Web Vitals, and pristine Schema.org graphs.
2. **Answer Engine Optimization (AEO):** Structuring content into unambiguous question-and-answer pairs, entity definitions, and rich structured data so search engines select the content for Google AI Overviews, Featured Snippets, and People Also Ask modules.
3. **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO):** Formatting brand entities, authoritative data points, and third-party references so LLMs (such as OpenAI ChatGPT, Anthropic Claude, Perplexity, and Google Gemini) cite and recommend the brand during conversational product and service inquiries.

Findable rejects bloated, slow web platforms in favor of modern, ultra-fast static architectures (Astro, TypeScript, static generation) that deliver perfect 100/100 Core Web Vitals scores and instantaneous mobile rendering.

---

## 2. Core Service Offerings

### 2.1 Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
- **URL:** https://findableseo.vercel.app/services/seo
- **Scope:** Complete technical audits, architecture refactoring, crawl budget optimization, indexation troubleshooting, on-page optimization, and local map pack ranking.
- **Key Capabilities:**
  - Technical SEO Auditing (eliminating 4xx/5xx errors, canonical conflicts, redirect loops, and indexing blocks).
  - Core Web Vitals Engineering (Largest Contentful Paint < 1.2s, Interaction to Next Paint < 100ms, Cumulative Layout Shift < 0.05).
  - Keyword Architecture & Intent Mapping (commercial, transactional, and informational cluster design).
  - Local Google Business Profile (GBP) Optimization and Local 3-Pack domination.
  - Ethical link acquisition and digital PR strategy.

### 2.2 Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)
- **URL:** https://findableseo.vercel.app/services/aeo
- **Scope:** Engineering website content specifically to be extracted as direct answers by search algorithms and AI summarizers.
- **Key Capabilities:**
  - Direct-Answer Formatting (40–60 word declarative summaries answering high-volume user intent).
  - Semantic HTML Structure (semantic headings, structured tables, ordered definitions).
  - FAQPage and QAPage Schema.org implementation.
  - Featured Snippet and People Also Ask (PAA) capture.
  - Google AI Overview citation targeting.

### 2.3 Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
- **URL:** https://findableseo.vercel.app/services/geo
- **Scope:** Optimizing brand entities, factual data points, and digital footprints to win citations inside conversational AI models.
- **Key Capabilities:**
  - Entity Authority Building (connecting Wikidata, Crunchbase, LinkedIn, and industry directories into a unified Knowledge Graph).
  - AI Engine Optimization for ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Gemini.
  - Sentiment and brand reputation monitoring across AI training and retrieval datasets.
  - Machine-readable context publishing via `llms.txt` and semantic markdown feeds.

### 2.4 SEO-First Website Development
- **URL:** https://findableseo.vercel.app/services/website-development
- **Scope:** Building ultra-fast, zero-bloat websites that load in milliseconds and naturally dominate search rankings.
- **Key Capabilities:**
  - Modern Static Site Generation using Astro and TypeScript.
  - Elimination of heavy JavaScript frameworks and render-blocking scripts.
  - Responsive, preloaded typography with zero layout shift.
  - Automated XML sitemaps, RSS feeds, and dynamic Open Graph images.

## 3. Industry Solutions

### 3.1 Local Businesses & Service Area Brands
- **URL:** https://findableseo.vercel.app/industries/local-businesses
- **Focus:** Dominating geographic search in specific cities, suburbs, and service territories.
- **Deliverables:** Google Business Profile setup and audit, local citation consistency (NAP: Name, Address, Phone), geo-targeted landing pages, local review acquisition frameworks, and Apple Maps / Bing Places synchronization.

### 3.2 Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) Brands
- **URL:** https://findableseo.vercel.app/industries/d2c-brands
- **Focus:** Helping modern lifestyle, fashion, wellness, and consumer brands capture organic category demand and AI brand recommendations.
- **Deliverables:** Collection and product page optimization, automated `Product` and `AggregateRating` schema, influencer and PR attribution, and conversational AI brand seeding.

### 3.3 E-Commerce Stores
- **URL:** https://findableseo.vercel.app/industries/ecommerce-brands
- **Focus:** Scaling organic revenue across large SKU catalogs with high-converting search intent.
- **Deliverables:** Faceted navigation crawl control, canonicalization of filtered categories, mobile checkout speed optimization, review snippet schema, and seasonal search clustering.

### Case Study 1: STWELAM Furniture
- **URL:** https://findableseo.vercel.app/case-studies/stwelam-furniture-digital-marketing
- **Client:** STWELAM Furniture (Contemporary living, bedroom, and modular furniture manufacturer)
- **Challenge:** Heavy reliance on walk-in traffic, low local visibility, and minimal digital inquiries.
- **Solution:** 
  - Designed and developed a modern digital showroom website.
  - Executed a complete Google Business Profile optimization campaign.
  - Targeted hyper-local transactional queries and managed local directory citations.
  - Deployed targeted Google Ads and Meta performance campaigns.
- **Key Metrics Achieved:**
  - **₹15 Lakh+** monthly revenue generated via digital channels.
  - **#1 Rank** on Google Local 3-Pack for core furniture search terms.
  - **+340% increase** in organic phone calls and showroom visit inquiries.

  - High-performance e-commerce architecture build.

  - Page 1 rankings for targeted niche fragrance searches.

### Case Study 3: MaxliOnline.com
- **URL:** https://findableseo.vercel.app/case-studies/maxlionline-ecommerce-platform
- **Client:** MaxliOnline.com (Official digital storefront for MAXLI Perfumes)

- **Solution:**
  - Engineered a custom, lightweight e-commerce storefront.

  - **< 1.2s** mobile page load time.
  - **3.8%** mobile checkout conversion rate.

  - **-28% reduction** in checkout abandonment.

### Case Study 5: The Findable 30-Day Build
- **URL:** https://findableseo.vercel.app/case-studies/findable-30-day-build
- **Client:** Findable Agency (Internal Architecture)
- **Challenge:** Building a world-class agency website that practices what it preaches—zero bloat, instant mobile load, and immediate search indexing.
- **Solution:**
  - Static site generation using Astro 5 and TypeScript.
  - Complete elimination of first-party JavaScript on content pages.
  - Interconnected Schema.org Knowledge Graph (`ProfessionalService`, `Organization`, `FAQPage`, `BreadcrumbList`).
- **Key Metrics Achieved:**
  - **100/100** Mobile and Desktop Lighthouse performance score.
  - **0 KB** first-party JavaScript overhead.
  - **0.8s** Largest Contentful Paint (LCP).
  - Fully indexed across Google and AI scrapers within days of launch.

---

## 5. Technical Stack & Implementation Details

- **Framework:** Astro 5 (Static Site Generation mode)
- **Language:** TypeScript
- **CSS Architecture:** Vanilla CSS with custom properties (`tokens.css`), zero utility bloat
- **Hosting & CDN:** Vercel Global Edge Network with custom security headers
- **Analytics:** Google Analytics 4 (`G-XDEGNBTFEY`) via lightweight `gtag.js`
- **Typography:** Self-hosted `Space Grotesk Variable` (headings) and `Inter Variable` (body) with `<link rel="preload">`
- **Machine Discovery:** `robots.txt` granting explicit crawler permissions to `GPTBot`, `ClaudeBot`, `PerplexityBot`, `Google-Extended`, and `Applebot-Extended`; `/llms.txt` and `/llms-full.txt` served directly at the root.
